_comment: ADCC women's 65kg/+65kg sourcing batch 2, 2026-08-27. Step 1 of the ingestion runbook
(sourcing only) -- nothing in this file has been downloaded or rendered yet.
Same shape as women_65.json: one row per DOWNLOADED video (frame_pdf.py's Entry --
url/start/end/label/note/kind/skip/transcript). Every row below carries `skip` because
none of the four resolved videos has a bout timestamp inside it yet -- each is a
full_event (a whole bracket replay or supercut), not a per-bout upload, and the task
that sourced this batch explicitly left timestamps for the capture step. A skip entry is
kept in the file rather than deleted for the same reason women_65.json gives: a video
that exists and was deliberately not rendered YET is a different fact from a fight
nobody found footage for. Once a bout's video-absolute start/end is located, split that
row into one Entry per bout (drop `skip`, add `start`/`end`) the same way
trials_2023_24_manifest.json splits pwGbW5GZgfc.
Every target bout inside these videos, resolved or not, is indexed with its published
winner in the sibling file women_65_batch2_bouts.json -- read that one for the actual
bout list. This file only tracks WHICH VIDEOS carry them.
Cross-reference note: pwGbW5GZgfc (the ADCC Trials Finals 2023-24 compilation) already
has a row in trials_2023_24_manifest.json with the Ana Vieira vs. Gabrielle McComb bout
at start=12140/end=12575 -- rendered (PDF exists under
data/frame_pdf/trials_2023_24/pendentes_gemini/processed/), not yet in a dump. It is
listed here too (skip) purely so this batch's manifest is a complete sourcing record;
do not re-render it from here.
FloGrappling row requires --cookies-from-browser (owner's logged-in session) at capture
time -- anonymous yt-dlp gets HTTP 403/paywall on these, same as every other Flo source
already in this repo (see women_65.json's Polaris rows).
Owner backlog NOT in this file (no resolvable URL yet, so no Entry row is honest -- a
fake url would just error out of yt-dlp at capture time): FloGrappling replay pages for
the Trials semifinals/quarterfinals below. Full target list with published winners is in
women_65_batch2_bouts.json; the ones with url=null there are this backlog:
- Helena Crevar def. Aurelie Le Vern, ADCC 2024 Worlds -65kg QF, heel hook 2:39
(checked: NOT covered by the already-ingested -65kg supercut dump -- that dump has
Opening Round / Semifinal / Bronze / Final only, no Quarterfinal round at all. Grep:
no 'Quarterfinal' stage and no 'Aurelie'/'Le Vern' anywhere in
scripts/dumps/supercut_the_entire_2024_adcc_worlds_65kg_bracket_data.py. Genuinely
missing footage, not a duplicate.)
- Helena Crevar def. Nicole Mathew, West Coast Trials 2024 SF, ankle lock
- Morgan Black def. Leilani Bernales, West Coast Trials 2024 SF, 2-0
- Helena Crevar def. Aislinn O'Connell, East Coast Trials 2023, ankle lock -- ALREADY
IN PROD with 0 events (scripts/dumps/adcc_trials2023_ec_semis_data.py has the row).
This is a RE-READ target (enrichment of an existing 0-event match), not a new bout.
- Amanda Leve x4, East Coast Trials 2023 +65kg bracket, all sub <3min -- opponents and
exact methods were not given in the sourcing task; needs a bracket sheet or the
owner's capture-time lookup before these can become four real bout rows.
